item.title: By: Nancy Yelm
item.dc:creator: Nancy Yelm
item.description: If this could be applied on a large scale I wonder how we might transform the world for the better. and not just to housing. Why couldn’t it be applied to many different things? I see no reason. Funny I am getting butterflys in the pit of my stomach. Who knows maybe I will be the one. Thank you.
